name: org.plantdatabases/askwheat
title: askWheat
description: Wheat genes, Watkins pangenome, QTL, expVIP expression, paper search, GWAS, AlphaFold, germplasm

tools.name: search_data
find_germplasm
tools.description:
Find wheat accessions/cultivars/lines by name or accession ID across five indexed sources: CropSNPdb
(SNP-genotyped lines, incl. all Australian Grains Genebank wheat and CAIGE breeding lines), the Watkins Wheat
Pangenome (sequenced landraces), OzWheat (CSIRO GWAS panel lines), FAIDARE (INRAE GnpIS collections, e.g. the
FRA040 Clermont-Ferrand wheat collection, and EVA European genebank evaluation sets) and genebank accessions of
Triticum and Aegilops from GBIF (holding genebank as FAO WIEWS code, e.g. MEX002 = CIMMYT, accession number;
mostly Svalbard safety duplicates).

tools.name: data_sources
tools.description:
What askWheat currently indexes: record counts per database and data type, and data versions; plus the live
endpoints it queries or offers (BrAPI nodes, the CropSNPdb genotype API, its own MCP server and JSON API).

tools.name: resolve_gene
tools.description:
Resolve a wheat gene symbol (e.g. Lr34, Rht-B1) or IWGSC gene ID in any RefSeq version
(v1.0 TraesCS..01G, v1.1 TraesCS..02G, v2.1 TraesCS..03G, CSS2014 Traes_..) to all versions,
genomic locations, curated symbol/trait (with verification status), Watkins pangenome presence and links.

tools.name: gene_function
tools.description:
IWGSC RefSeq v2.1 functional annotation (InterPro, Pfam, Gene Ontology) for a gene symbol or any-version
IWGSC ID. annotation_types filters e.g. ['Gene Ontology'] or ['Pfam','InterPro'].

tools.name: genes_in_region
tools.description:
List IWGSC genes overlapping a region. chromosome like '7D'; assembly 'v2.1' (RefSeq v2.1 coordinates)
or 'v1.0' (RefSeq v1.0 coordinates, v1.1 gene IDs). Region size is capped at 20 Mb.

tools.name: find_marker
wheat_homologues
tools.description:
Homoeologues (the A/B/D copies), and orthologues in other grasses and Arabidopsis, of a bread wheat gene from
Ensembl Plants Compara gene trees. gene: symbol or any IWGSC ID (converted to RefSeq v1.1). By default
orthologues are listed for durum and wild emmer, T. urartu, Ae. tauschii, rye, barley, oat, Brachypodium, rice,
maize, sorghum and Arabidopsis; target_species takes Ensembl names instead (e.g. ['triticum_aestivum_mace',
'hordeum_vulgare_goldenpromise'] for pan-genome cultivars). include_paralogues adds within-wheat paralogues
(same-genome duplicates). Relationships: homoeolog_one2one, ortholog_one2one/one2many/many2many.

tools.name: wheat_gene_in_cultivars
tools.description:
The corresponding genes of a Chinese Spring gene in the other bread wheat genome assemblies of the 21-genome
pangenome: Ensembl Plants Compara orthologues in ArinaLrFor, Jagger, Julius, Kariega, Lancer, Landmark, Mace,
Mattis, Norin 61, Paragon, Renan and Stanley, each with its gene ID, chromosome position and a link to this
site's genome browser for that assembly. gene: symbol or any IWGSC ID. same_subgenome_only keeps the copy on the
same subgenome as the query (Compara also lists the homoeologous copies). Cultivars without a Compara orthologue,
and assemblies outside Compara (Cadenza, Claire, Robigus, Weebil, Fielder, Zang1817, Attraktion, Aikang 58), are
listed: search those with blast_sequence against their genome database.

tools.name: rice_function
tools.description:
Function of a wheat gene through its rice orthologue(s): Ensembl Plants Compara orthologues in Oryza sativa
Japonica (RAP IDs, Os03g0707600), then Gramene's curated rice gene name and synonyms (e.g. SLR1, Hd1), Trait
Ontology terms (phenotypes linked to the gene), QTL traits, Plant Ontology (where/when studied), Plant Reactome
reactions and PubMed IDs. gene: a wheat symbol or any IWGSC ID, or a rice RAP ID directly. Rice is the best
studied cereal, so this often names a wheat gene that has no curated function of its own; the wheat gene's
function is inferred, not shown. All one2many / many2many orthologues are listed.

tools.name: wheat_mutants
tools.description:
Induced mutations and natural variants in and around a bread wheat gene. source 'ems' (default): EMS mutant
lines of tetraploid Kronos and hexaploid Cadenza with exome-capture sequencing (Krasileva et al. 2017; 2,735
lines), giving the line ID to order, e.g. Cadenza1158; 'diversity': exome-capture variants of 890 landraces and
cultivars (He et al. 2019) and 103 Watkins landraces; 'all'. Every variant Ensembl assigns to the gene is kept:
coding, splice, UTR, intron and upstream/downstream (within 5 kb). consequence filters: 'truncating' (stop gained,
splice donor/acceptor, start/stop lost), 'missense', 'coding', 'splice', 'utr', 'intron', 'flanking'
(upstream/downstream), 'regulatory' (flanking + UTR) or a Sequence Ontology term. homoeologues=True adds the A/B/D
copies (to stack knockouts). gene: symbol or any IWGSC ID (converted to RefSeq v1.1); positions are RefSeq v1.0.

tools.name: wheat_variants_in_region
tools.description:
EMS mutations and exome-capture variants in a bread wheat interval on IWGSC RefSeq v1.0, including intergenic
ones (promoters, unannotated regions, off-target capture). region: 'chr:start-end', e.g. '3A:100000000-100500000'
(max 5 Mb). source 'ems', 'diversity' or 'all' (default); consequence as in wheat_mutants, plus 'intergenic'.
Genic variants name the gene (RefSeq v1.1); use genes_in_region for the genes near intergenic ones.

tools.name: wheat_mutant_line
tools.description:
Every mutation Ensembl lists for one EMS line (Cadenza or Kronos exome-capture TILLING; Krasileva et al. 2017),
e.g. 'Cadenza1166' or 'Kronos2235': counts by consequence, the genes with truncating mutations, and the mutations
(gene, consequence, amino-acid change, RefSeq v1.0 position), most severe first. consequence filters as in
wheat_mutants ('truncating', 'missense', ...); chromosome e.g. '6D'. Use it to judge a line's background load and
to check for off-target hits near a gene of interest before crossing.

tools.name: wheat_knockout_screen
tools.description:
Which genes have EMS alleles in every homoeologue, i.e. can be knocked out across A, B and D by crossing
Cadenza/Kronos lines. For each gene (genes: up to 300 symbols or IWGSC IDs, or region: RefSeq v1.0 interval up to
10 Mb, e.g. a QTL) the A/B/D copies come from Ensembl Compara, and each copy gets its lines with a consequence
'truncating' (default; stop, splice donor/acceptor, start/stop lost) or 'missense' etc. Status 'all_copies',
'partial' or 'none'; complete_only keeps 'all_copies'. Kronos lines cover only A and B copies; D copies need
Cadenza. Lines hitting two copies at once are flagged.

tools.name: watkins_gene_presence
tools.description:
Presence/absence of one gene across the 1,038 Watkins pangenome accessions: present count, core/variable,
counts by ancestral group (AG1-AG7, Modern), continent and growth habit, UniProt/GO annotation and links.
gene: symbol, any IWGSC RefSeq ID, or a pangenome gene-model ID.

tools.name: watkins_gene_accessions
tools.description:
Watkins accessions that carry (present=True) or lack (present=False) a gene, optionally filtered by
country, continent, ancestral_group (AG1-AG7 or Modern) or growth_habit. Returns metadata, coordinates and
Seedstor ordering links.

tools.name: watkins_compare_groups
tools.description:
Genes whose presence frequency differs most between two sets of Watkins accessions.
group_a / group_b as '<field>:<value>' with field one of group (ancestral group), country, continent,
growth_habit, e.g. 'group:AG3' vs 'group:Modern', 'country:India' vs 'country:China'.
min_diff is the minimum absolute frequency difference (0-1). Negative diff = more common in group_b.

tools.name: watkins_find_genes
tools.description:
Find Watkins pangenome genes by UniProt protein name, gene name, protein family or ID fragment
(e.g. 'FAR1', 'NLR', 'Disease resistance protein RGA'). Returns gene IDs with UniProt/GO annotation.

tools.name: watkins_accession
tools.description:
One Watkins accession (e.g. WATDE0063, or a synonym): origin, ancestral group, coordinates, Seedstor link,
number of genes present, presence/absence of the listed genes (symbols or any IWGSC IDs accepted), all its
phenotype records (trial, trait, value, units) and any RIL populations it is a parent of.

tools.name: watkins_phenotypes
tools.description:
Field/glasshouse phenotypes of Watkins accessions (heading, height, grain size/weight/quality, senescence,
lodging, rust and mildew scores, morphology). With no arguments, lists the trials (JIC UK 2006-2020, Egypt
2019-2021, Limagrain seedling yellow rust 2020, Kenya/Ethiopia rust 2013) and trait names with units.
Filter by accession (e.g. WATDE0063), exact trait name, trial and/or country.

tools.name: watkins_gene_trait
tools.description:
Compare a trait between Watkins accessions that carry vs lack a gene, per trial: n, mean and median per
group and a Mann-Whitney p-value (exploratory; no correction for population structure). gene: symbol, any
IWGSC RefSeq ID or pangenome gene-model ID. trait: exact name from watkins_phenotypes (e.g. 'Heading time').

tools.name: watkins_populations
tools.description:
Paragon x Watkins (and a few Robigus/other x Watkins) RIL populations: Watkins parent, country, ancestral
group, number of RILs, GRU seed code, genetic map type and whether it donated TK-NILs. With population (e.g.
'ParW034') or watkins_parent (e.g. 'WATDE0005') also lists the trials in which its lines were phenotyped.

tools.name: watkins_population_phenotypes
tools.description:
Trial phenotypes (line means per trial) of Paragon x Watkins RILs and TK-NILs: heading, height, yield, grain
traits, biomass, N content and more from JIC, Rothamsted and Nottingham trials (2011-2022). population_type 'RIL',
'NIL' or 'check' (parents and controls, e.g. Paragon). line matches by prefix (e.g. 'ParW034_0012' also returns NILs
derived from it). With no arguments, lists trials and traits.

tools.name: watkins_trait_genes
tools.description:
Which variable genes differ in presence between Watkins accessions with high vs low values of a trait in one
trial (e.g. late vs early heading). Accessions are split into top/bottom quartile (split: quartile, tercile,
median) within each ancestral group (stratify_by_group) and every variable gene is tested (Cochran-Mantel-Haenszel,
Benjamini-Hochberg FDR). direction 'high' = genes more frequent in high-trait accessions, 'low' the reverse.
trait and trial are exact names from watkins_phenotypes(). Exploratory screen, not a GWAS.

tools.name: watkins_nil_genes
tools.description:
Genes inside the Watkins introgression of a TK-NIL (Watkins segment in a Paragon background), with presence in
the Watkins donor and frequency in modern cultivars and landraces. nil_line is a NIL line name from
watkins_population_phenotypes (e.g. 'ParW141_0016-7-10-Q2D-Hd-P'). The interval comes from the NIL name
(chromosome-start-end on RefSeq v1.0). Highlights genes the donor lacks but most modern cultivars carry, and
genes the donor carries but most modern cultivars lack (Paragon itself is not in the pangenome).

tools.name: watkins_extra_genes
tools.description:
Genes found on the Watkins pangenome extra contigs: sequence not in the 21 wheat genome assemblies, assembled
from the reads of 827 Watkins landraces and 217 modern cultivars (163,778 gene models; 34,295 with a confident
UniProt match, of which 10,426 occur only in landraces). Use it for genes that modern wheat lacks.
gene: one gene model ID (e.g. maker-asm3_jcf7180084687145-snap-gene-0.8) -> its contig, annotation, presence by
ancestral group and the accessions carrying it. Otherwise lists genes: query = words or a UniProt accession matched
against gene name, protein name and family (e.g. 'NLR', 'disease resistance protein RPM1', 'Q9SZL8');
presence = landrace_only | modern_only | shared | any; group = ancestral group the gene must be present in (AG1-AG7,
Modern); nlr = only genes overlapping the 176 landrace-specific NLR loci (NLR-Annotator); disease / stress = GO-based
flags; annotated_only = only genes with a UniProt match; min_accessions = minimum number of carriers.
Absence means reads did not cover the gene model (divergence or low coverage are possible); rare genes were
assembled from few reads.

tools.name: watkins_nlr_cluster
tools.description:
A landrace-specific NLR cluster in the Watkins pangenome: nine NLR loci that co-occur in 58
Watkins landraces (mainly AG4, AG3, AG6; Afghanistan, former USSR, Greece, Iran, Spain) and are absent from all 217
modern cultivars, including a complete CC-NBARC-LRR gene (best UniProt match rice blast resistance protein Pikm2),
placed by read-pair links near TraesCS2A02G590100 on distal 2AL. Returns the 58 carriers and the NLR genes.

tools.name: wheat_segment_pav
tools.description:
Which of the 21 wheat genome assemblies of the UWA graph pangenome (Chinese Spring, ArinaLrFor, Cadenza, Claire,
Jagger, Julius, Kariega, Lancer, Landmark, Mace, Mattis, Norin61, Paragon, Renan, Robigus, Stanley, Weebil, Fielder,
Zang1817, Attraktion, Aikang58) carry each stretch of graph sequence: presence/absence variation beyond genes.
Region mode: region = 'chrom:start-end' on Chinese Spring RefSeq v1.0 (<= 10 Mb), or gene = a symbol / IWGSC ID
(its v1.0 position +- flank). Returns how much Chinese Spring sequence each assembly lacks there, the variable
intervals (largest first), and non-reference sequence (present in other assemblies, not Chinese Spring) inserted
in the region, anchored by the graph's flanking Chinese Spring segments. assembly = another assembly id (e.g.
Wheat_Cadenza) with region on that assembly's own sequence names: only the non-reference graph sequence that came
from that assembly has coordinates there.
Group mode: present_in / absent_in = cultivar lists -> intervals in all of present_in and none of absent_in
(genome-wide, or one chromosome), with totals and the largest intervals. Can combine with region or gene.
min_length = smallest interval reported (bp).

tools.name: watkins_gene_haplotypes
tools.description:
Haplotypes of a gene across the Watkins landraces and modern cultivars (WatSeq, 1,051 accessions). 'snp'
(default where built): accessions grouped by their SNP alleles in the gene +-2 kb (MAF >= 0.02), each haplotype
with its coding changes (e.g. p.Arg134Gln), whether it is Chinese Spring-like, size and frequency by ancestral
group (AG1-AG7, Modern) and country; 'ibspy': the IBSpy haplotype group of the 1 Mb block holding the gene, with
the pangenome assemblies (e.g. jagger-pg, mace-pg) that share each block haplotype. Accessions lacking the gene in
the Watkins pangenome are listed as 'absent'. gene: symbol or any IWGSC ID (positions RefSeq v1.0).

tools.name: watkins_haplotype_trait
tools.description:
Trait values per haplotype of a gene (watkins_gene_haplotypes) in each Watkins trial: n, mean and median per
haplotype and a Kruskal-Wallis test across haplotypes with >= min_n accessions. Exploratory: no correction for
population structure or multiple testing, so a difference can reflect ancestry rather than the gene. trait: exact
name from watkins_phenotypes (e.g. 'Heading time'); trial optional (all trials otherwise). include_values adds
each accession's mean per haplotype (for plotting).

tools.name: watkins_lof_alleles
tools.description:
Watkins landraces and modern cultivars carrying a predicted loss-of-function allele of a gene (WatSeq, 1,051
accessions): each stop-gained, start/stop-lost or splice-site SNP with its protein change, the number of
homozygous and heterozygous carriers, and the carriers (accession, ancestral group, country) for ordering from the
JIC Germplasm Resources Unit. gene: symbol or any IWGSC ID; homoeologues are listed for checking redundancy.

tools.name: watkins_accession_lof
tools.description:
Genes with a predicted loss-of-function allele (stop gained, start/stop lost, splice site) in one Watkins
landrace or modern cultivar (WatSeq). accession: Watkins store code or WatSeq sample name (e.g. 'Watkins 1190027',
'WATDE0027', 'Paragon'). genes optionally restricts to a gene list (symbols or IWGSC IDs). Rare alleles (carried by
few accessions) are listed first.

tools.name: expression_experiments
tools.description:
Bread wheat RNA-seq experiments held by askWheat (Expression Atlas, the expVIP compendium (33 studies on RefSeq v1.1, EXPVIP-* experiments) and SRA study SRP045409 (seedling drought, heat and combined stress; quantified by askWheat)): baseline (TPM by
tissue / developmental stage / treatment) and differential (stress, pathogen, genotype contrasts). query filters descriptions/labels (e.g. 'drought',
'grain', 'Fusarium'). Gives each experiment's assay groups (baseline) or contrasts (differential).

tools.name: gene_expression
tools.description:
Where and when a wheat gene is expressed, and under which treatments it changes, from Expression Atlas, the expVIP compendium (33 studies on RefSeq v1.1, EXPVIP-* experiments) and SRA study SRP045409 (seedling drought, heat and combined stress; quantified by askWheat).
gene: symbol or any IWGSC RefSeq ID (converted to v1.1, as used by Atlas). Baseline: TPM (median over replicates,
with range) for the top_groups highest-expressed tissues/stages per experiment. Differential: every contrast where
the gene is significant (adjusted p < 0.05, |log2FC| >= 1). experiment restricts to one accession; otherwise the
max_experiments baseline experiments with the highest TPM are detailed and the rest listed with their maximum.

tools.name: expression_genes
tools.description:
Genes characteristic of a tissue/stage or responsive to a treatment in one Expression Atlas experiment.
Baseline experiment + group (text matched to group labels, e.g. 'root', 'grain'): genes with TPM >= min_tpm in a
matching group ranked by specificity = (max TPM in matching groups + 1) / (max TPM in other groups + 1).
Differential experiment + contrast (text matched to contrast names or IDs): significant genes, direction 'up' or
'down', ranked by |log2FC|. Use expression_experiments() for group and contrast names.

tools.name: wheat_homoeologue_expression
tools.description:
Relative expression of a wheat gene's A, B and D homoeologues per tissue/stage (Expression Atlas and expVIP
baseline experiments), with the homoeologue expression balance category of each tissue: balanced, A/B/D dominant
or A/B/D suppressed, by distance to the ideal proportions (Ramirez-Gonzalez et al. 2018). Categories are given only
for 1:1:1 triads with summed TPM >= 0.5. Without experiment: every tissue of the 209-sample expVIP developmental
atlas (EXPVIP-Development, 70 tissue/stage groups of cv. Azhurnaya) plus the category counts of every other
experiment and an overall summary; experiment restricts to one accession with all its tissues.

tools.name: wheat_coexpressed_genes
tools.description:
Wheat genes co-expressed with a wheat gene across the expVIP RNA-seq compendium (about 970 samples in 317
tissue x age x stress x variety groups, RefSeq v1.1), for guessing function and shortlisting candidates (e.g. genes
under a QTL that behave like a known gene). Pearson r of log2(TPM + 1) across the groups; top partners with
their RefSeq v2.1 ID, location and description; the gene's own homoeologues are flagged (they usually rank
first). gene: symbol or any IWGSC ID (converted to v1.1). top: up to 50; min_r: drop weaker partners.
Co-expression is association, not interaction or regulation; say so, and that askWheat computed it.

tools.name: snp_lines
tools.description:
Find SNP-genotyped lines in CropSNPdb by name or accession (e.g. 'Cadenza', 'AGG 38862', 'CAIGE ZWB17' or a CAIGE GID '7396745').
Returns line name, accession(s), country, pedigree, status, breeding organisation and donor. dataset: 'wheat40k' (default) or 'wheat90k'.

tools.name: snp_genotypes
tools.description:
SNP genotype calls for up to 50 lines in a region (chromosome like '2D'). Returns markers with positions
and each line's call. Keep regions small (a few Mb) for many lines.

tools.name: snp_compare_lines
tools.description:
Compare two lines' SNP genotypes on a chromosome (optionally a region): markers compared, identical,
different, % identity and the regions where they differ (useful for pedigree/introgression questions).

tools.name: snp_haplotype_carriers
tools.description:
Lines that share a reference line's SNP haplotype in a region (max 5 Mb), e.g. which genebank lines carry the
Cadenza haplotype around a gene. Only markers polymorphic in the panel (minor allele frequency >= min_maf) are
used, and a match needs calls at >= min_called of them with at most max_mismatch differences. Always report
informative_markers and fraction_matching; if 'note' says the haplotype is common, say it is not diagnostic.

tools.name: snp_markers
tools.description: SNP markers (IDs and positions) of a CropSNPdb dataset in a region, with the total count.

tools.name: snp_phenotypes
tools.description:
Field trial trait data held in CropSNPdb for this crop (T3 trials with Crop Ontology trait IDs, Australian Grains Genebank records). With no arguments, lists the
available traits. Filter by line and/or trait: trait matches the
exact name or any part of it (e.g. 'Height', 'grain yield'). Most phenotyped lines are in the
wheat90k dataset.

tools.name: ozwheat_mtas
tools.description:
Marker-trait associations from the OzWheat GWAS (285 Australian and international wheat cultivars and lines;
glasshouse 2016 and field trials at Canberra 2018-19, Wagga 2018, Narrabri 2019). Traits: days to anthesis,
days to heading, degree-days to heading ('flowering'/'heading') and plant height. Filter by trait, gene (symbol or
any IWGSC ID; matches the gene carrying the SNP or the linked candidate gene, or the name in their annotation) and/or region (chromosome like '7B'
with start/end in RefSeq v1.0 bp). Each MTA gives the peak SNP and its position, p-value, the gene it sits in
(with v1.1/v2.1 IDs), any literature candidate gene, and the allele effect: trait mean (BLUE) of lines carrying
each allele in that trial.

tools.name: ozwheat_lines
tools.description:
OzWheat diversity panel lines (285 Australian and international cultivars and breeding lines): name, OzWheat ID,
Australian Grains Genebank (AGG) accession, pedigree and phenotype BLUEs (days to anthesis/heading, degree-days to
heading, height per trial). query matches name, OzWheat ID (oz0001), AGG number or pedigree words. marker (an
OzWheat MTA peak SNP such as 'SNP34815_7B', from ozwheat_mtas) with allele lists the lines carrying that allele.
include_genotypes adds each line's calls at all MTA peak markers. Lines are also often in CropSNPdb under the
same cultivar name (use snp_lines).

tools.name: genebank_phenotypes
tools.description:
Field phenotypes of wheat cultivars and genebank accessions from IPK e!DAL (CC BY 4.0). Datasets: 'GABI-WHEAT'
(372 European elite cultivars 1975-2007; 16 traits incl. grain yield, heading, height, TKW, protein, sedimentation,
falling number, FHB, Septoria, tan spot; BLUEs per trial environment and across 2009-2010 trials in Germany/France),
'IPK' (12,754 IPK genebank accessions, TRI numbers: flowering time, plant height, TKW, BLUEs across 70 years of
regeneration), 'EU-GENEBANKS' (about 40,000 accessions of CREA, ICARDA, IHAR, INIA, IPGR, NARDI, NPPC, Agroscope:
heading, height, TKW, some disease, protein and yield). No arguments lists datasets and traits.
query: a cultivar name or accession number (e.g. 'Julius', 'TRI 1000', 'IG 107099') -> all its trait values.
trait (+ order 'high'/'low'): rank accessions of one dataset. filters: several traits at once, e.g.
'plant height < 90; thousand kernel weight > 45' (BLUEs, one dataset). genebank: FAO code or name (LBN002, CREA);
country: origin (IPK dataset).

tools.name: brapi_germplasm_studies
tools.description:
Phenotyping studies (field and glasshouse trials) with trait data for a wheat line, live from the BrAPI nodes
(the INRAE wheat trial network and Whealbi trials in GnpIS (served through FAIDARE) and T3/Wheat, the Triticeae Toolbox (US breeding programmes and regional nurseries)). germplasm: a cultivar or line name (matched exactly; upper/title case are tried too, e.g.
'Soissons' -> 'SOISSONS'). Returns the matching germplasm records (source, holding institute, accession) and each
study's name, trial/network, season, location, number of observations, variables measured and link. Use
brapi_observations for the trait values.

tools.name: brapi_observations
tools.description:
Trait observations for a wheat line from the BrAPI nodes (the INRAE wheat trial network and Whealbi trials in GnpIS (served through FAIDARE) and T3/Wheat, the Triticeae Toolbox (US breeding programmes and regional nurseries)), summarised per study and variable:
n, mean, min, max (numeric values) or the distinct values, season and location. germplasm: line name (as in
brapi_germplasm_studies). trait filters variables by name or ontology ID part (e.g. 'rdt', 'CO_321:1000074',
'yield'; INRAE short names are glossed: rdt = grain yield, prot = grain protein, pmg = thousand-grain weight, ht
= plant height, rj/rb = yellow/brown rust). study filters by study name part (e.g. 'Le_Moulon', '2015').
Compare values within a study.

tools.name: trait_ontology
tools.description:
Ontology terms for a wheat trait, to annotate data or match trial variables: Wheat Crop Ontology (CO_321)
variables (trait + method + scale, e.g. 'Heading time - days', with definitions) as used by T3/Wheat and other
BrAPI databases, and Planteome Plant Trait Ontology (TO) classes (e.g. TO:0000137 days to heading). query: trait
words ('days to heading', 'grain protein', 'stripe rust'). A CO_321 variable ID is what trial data and BrAPI
observations use; a TO ID is the cross-species trait class.

tools.name: t3_find_studies
tools.description:
Find T3/Wheat trials (US breeding programmes and regional nurseries) by whole words in the study name or
description ('heat', 'drought', 'stripe rust', 'nitrogen'), season range, location ('Kansas', 'Davis') or
programme ('Kansas State'). Returns study name, programme, location, season, design and the T3 trial link,
newest first; then use brapi_observations / brapi_germplasm_studies for data. Pass on T3's data usage policy given in 'terms' (Toronto
Statement on prepublication data) and that trial pages need a T3 login; cite T3 (Morales et al. 2022, doi:10.1093/g3journal/jkac078).

tools.name: wheat_gene_catalogue
tools.description:
Catalogue of Gene Symbols for Wheat (McIntosh et al., GrainGenes; 2024 edition): the official register of
designated wheat genes and alleles. query: a gene or allele symbol ('Lr34', 'Rht-B1b'), locus ('Rht-B1' lists
all its alleles), old synonym ('Rht1', 'Ppd1', 'NAM-B1'), trait words matching a catalogue section ('stem rust',
'height', 'vernalization', 'glutenin') or any text (a cultivar, marker or stock name). chromosome filters by arm
or chromosome ('2D', '7DS'). Each entry gives its section, synonyms, chromosome, the catalogue text (stocks
i:/v:, markers ma:, cloning c:) and, with full, the cited references resolved. Use resolve_gene for the IWGSC
gene ID of cloned genes.

tools.name: kasp_assays
tools.description:
Published KASP assays for wheat genes and SNPs, with primer sequences, alleles, RefSeq v1.0 position and the
allele calls reported for cultivars. Sources: 70 functional assays of Rasheed et al. 2016 (Rht-B1/D1, Ppd-A1/B1/D1,
Vrn-A1/B1/D1, Lr34, Lr21, Lr47, Lr68, Sr2, Yr15, Yr36, Fhb1, Glu-A1/D1, Pina/Pinb, Gpc-B1, TaGW/TGW, PHS, colour
and quality genes; calls in ~300 cultivars) and the CerealsDB KASP core set (960 varietal SNPs with Avalon x
Cadenza map positions; calls in 169 mostly UK varieties). query: gene symbol or synonym (Rht-B1, Rht1, Lr34,
Ppd-D1), v1.1 gene ID, marker/primer name (BS00024039, Vrn1_new) or trait words (vernalization, preharvest
sprouting). region: RefSeq v1.0 interval '4B:30.5-31.5Mb' for assays placed there. line: cultivar name (partial
match) to list its calls (with query: only that gene's assays; alone: all assays scored in that line).
include_calls: lines listed per allele call (0 = counts only when no line is given).

tools.name: cereal_trait_genes
tools.description:
Genes cloned in rice for a trait, with their wheat orthologues (A/B/D copies, Ensembl Compara), and rice QTL for
the trait; or, for a wheat or rice gene, what the rice orthologue is known to control. Sources: funRiceGenes (cloned
rice genes with trait keywords, papers and evidence sentences) and Q-TARO (1,051 rice QTL). trait: words such as
'grain size', 'heading date', 'drought', 'blast resistance', 'tiller'. gene: a wheat gene (TraesCS ID or symbol, e.g.
TaGW2) or a rice RAP ID / symbol (Os02g0244100, GW2). Rice gene function in wheat is inferred by orthology: say so,
give the orthology type, and use wheat_mutants / watkins_gene_haplotypes / kasp_assays to test the wheat copies.

tools.name: cereal_pangenome_presence
tools.description:
Whether a gene is present and conserved across the barley pangenome (Morex plus 76 cultivars, landraces and wild
barley) and rice assemblies (Nipponbare, 15 Asian rice cultivars, wild Oryza) in Ensembl Plants. gene: a wheat gene
(TraesCS ID or symbol; its barley and rice orthologues from Ensembl Compara are used), a barley Morex ID
(HORVU.MOREX.r3...) or a rice RAP ID. crop: 'barley' or 'rice' (default both). For each reference gene: number of
assemblies with a reciprocal best hit, a one-way hit, or no hit (possible absence or divergence), and the identity
range. assemblies: list up to N assemblies per class. Absence of a hit can be an annotation gap: check the genome
before calling a deletion.

tools.name: barley_cloned_genes
tools.description:
Barley genes cloned for disease resistance (Rpg1, Rpg5 stem rust; Rph1, Rph3 leaf rust; Mla, Mlo powdery mildew;
rym4/5 bymovirus) and agronomic traits (Ppd-H1, HvFT1, HvELF3, HvCEN, Vrs1, sdw1, uzu, Nud), with the cloning
paper, the MorexV3 gene matching the cloned allele's protein, and its wheat A/B/D orthologues from the local
Ensembl Compara copy. query: symbol or trait words ('leaf rust', 'flowering'); category 'disease' or 'agronomic'.
Use cereal_pangenome_presence on the Morex gene for presence across the barley pangenome. Cite the papers.

tools.name: editing_candidates
tools.description:
Rank wheat gene-editing targets for a trait: genes cloned in rice for the trait (funRiceGenes, ranked by papers)
whose wheat orthologues have little functional variation in the Watkins landraces and modern lines (so the
variation cannot be selected by crossing), are expressed in the target tissue, and have Kronos EMS truncating
alleles in the A and B copies (testable now as double knockouts). trait: words as for cereal_trait_genes ('grain
size', 'heading date', 'tiller'); tissue: grain, spike, leaf, root or stem (expression filter); candidates: rice
genes examined (most-cited first). Score 0-100 = donor evidence (25) + one-to-one orthology (15) + no common
coding variation in expressed copies (25) + expressed (15) + Kronos truncating lines in A and B (20); each part is
returned. A candidate list to check, not a result.

tools.name: gwas_associations
tools.description:
Published GWAS marker-trait associations curated by GWAS Atlas (CNCB-NGDC), each with its position, trait
(Plant Trait Ontology), p-value, R2, population and paper (PMID). Data here: wheat (35,430 associations from 96 papers, IWGSC RefSeq v1.0, with the nearest RefSeq v1.1 gene) and rye (3,509 associations from 2 papers, Lo7 = Ensembl secale_cereale). trait: words
('plant height', 'stripe rust', 'grain yield'); region: 'chromosome:start-end' on the stated assembly (e.g.
'6A:8-9Mb'); gene: a gene ID or symbol, giving associations within window_kb of it; species: limit to one species
(Ensembl name; default triticum_aestivum, 'all' for every species); max_p: keep p-values at or below this. Results are sorted by p-value; by_trait and by_paper
summarise all matches.

tools.name: wheat_qtl
tools.description:
Wheat QTL from WheatQTLdb v2.0 (27,021 QTL, 1,321 meta-QTL and 202 epistatic QTL curated from the literature,
for yield, quality, disease and pest resistance, abiotic stress, nutrient use and more). Search by trait words
('grain weight', 'stripe rust', 'heat'), RefSeq v1.0 region ('6A:230000000-250000000'), gene (symbol or IWGSC
ID; QTL with an associated marker within window_kb), chromosome, kind ('QTL', 'metaQTL', 'epistatic') and species
(also Triticum durum, Aegilops tauschii...). Returns trait, QTL name, cross, population, method, cM position,
markers, PVE, candidate genes and the paper link, with physical marker positions where the markers could be
placed (about 38% of records). Cite WheatQTLdb and each record's paper.

tools.name: paper_qtl
tools.description:
QTL and marker-trait associations read from the tables of open-access wheat papers (PubMed Central full
text, mostly 2015 onwards). Complements WheatQTLdb and GWAS Atlas. Search by trait words (matched in the table's trait column and caption),
chromosome ('2A'), region (RefSeq v1.0 region '6A:230-250Mb') or gene (window_kb around it); rows carry the RefSeq v1.0 position of the marker where it could be placed (IWGSC marker alignments). Each row gives the
trait, QTL name, marker, chromosome, the position as reported (assembly as stated in the paper), cM, LOD, p, PVE,
the table caption and the paper with its licence. Reported positions may be on RefSeq v1.0 or v2.1, as stated in each paper. Tables were parsed automatically: check a
surprising row in the paper.

tools.name: wheat_dgenome_lineage
tools.description:
Which Ae. tauschii lineage and subpopulation each 50-kb window of a bread wheat D genome came from, for 17 wheat
genomes (Chinese Spring, ArinaLrFor, Jagger, Julius, Kariega, Lancer, Landmark, Mace, Mattis, Norin 61, Stanley,
Fielder, Attraktion, Aikang 58, Zang1817, PI190962 and landrace CWI 86942), from IBSpy k-mer matching to 493
Ae. tauschii accessions (Cavalet-Giorsa et al. 2024). cultivar alone: share of each lineage and top K9
subpopulations per D chromosome; with region ('2D:30-40Mb', on that cultivar's own assembly): the windows; gene
(symbol or IWGSC ID): the window at the gene in Chinese Spring (RefSeq v1.0) and at its Compara orthologue in the
other cultivars. L2 = ssp. strangulata (main donor); L1/L3 segments show introgression from other lineages.

tools.name: aetauschii_gene
tools.description:
Gene models of the three Ae. tauschii lineage reference assemblies (TA10171 lineage 1, TA1675 lineage 2, TA2576
lineage 3; Cavalet-Giorsa et al. 2024) matched by protein similarity (DIAMOND, best hit) to Ensembl Plants Ae.
tauschii Aet v4.0 and Chinese Spring RefSeq v1.1 D-genome genes. gene: an Aet.TA1675.r1... ID gives its position
and matches; a wheat symbol, IWGSC ID or Ensembl AET ID gives the matching genes in each lineage reference, with
genome-browser links. Best-hit matching is not orthology: check identity and coverage; a lineage with no match
may lack the gene or have a missed gene model.

tools.name: panel_haplotypes
tools.description:
SNP haplotypes of a gene across a diversity panel: accessions grouped by their SNP alleles in the gene
+-2 kb (MAF >= 0.02, <= 20% missing), each haplotype with size, number of alternative alleles, whether it is
reference-like and its accessions, plus the SNPs (position, alleles, frequency). Panels: 'aet_tauschii_1022' = Ae. tauschii diversity panel, 1,022 sequenced accessions (lineages 1-3, incl. the 493 non-redundant set; sample names as in the VCF, e.g. TA1675, AL878, BW_01034), short-read SNPs on the TA1675 lineage 2 reference within 2 kb of its high-confidence genes (Aet.TA1675.r1... IDs; find them from a wheat gene with aetauschii_gene).
gene: an Ae. tauschii TA1675 gene ID (Aet.TA1675.r1.4D005250); find it from a wheat gene with aetauschii_gene

tools.name: search_literature
tools.description:
Search publications and preprints in Europe PMC (PubMed, PMC, bioRxiv and others).

query: free text or Europe PMC syntax (e.g. 'grain size QTL 6A', 'TITLE:"pan-genome"').
gene: optional gene symbol or IWGSC ID; its curated synonyms and RefSeq IDs are OR-ed into the query
(e.g. gene='Lr34' also matches Yr18, Sr57, TraesCS7D02G080300).
Words are matched in title and abstract; full_text=True also searches open-access full text.
crop_only requires wheat/Triticum/Aegilops in title or abstract. sort: 'relevance', 'date' (newest first) or 'cited'.
Returns hit count and papers with DOI/PMID, year, journal, open-access flag, citations and a short abstract.

tools.name: get_paper
tools.description:
Full record for one paper: DOI (10.xxxx/..), PMID (digits) or PMCID (PMC...). Returns the abstract,
open-access status and full-text links.

tools.name: literature_gene_traits
tools.description:
Genes and Plant Trait Ontology terms mentioned together in open-access full-text papers (found with Europe PMC,
text from PubMed Central), mined by askCrop: in the same sentence (level 'sentence', stronger) or the same paragraph
of at most three genes (level 'paragraph'); tables and references are skipped. gene: a gene ID (or wheat symbol) gives the papers that name it and the traits it co-occurs with,
with example sentences; trait: words ('grain size', 'drought', 'flowering time') gives the genes most often named
alongside it. A co-mention is text evidence to read, not a demonstrated gene function: check the sentence and
paper. Each paper carries its licence: quote verbatim with citation, and summarise rather than reword quotes from
ND-licensed papers. Only papers whose full text is open access are covered.

tools.name: search_papers
tools.description:
Find open-access full-text papers that answer a question, by meaning as well as keywords (e.g. 'what limits
grain filling under heat stress', 'genes controlling spike architecture'). Combines vector search
(BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5 embeddings) and keyword search, ranked by reciprocal rank fusion, and groups the hits by
paper: limit counts papers (default 10, max 50), each with its best passages (passages_per_paper 1-3) and section.
papers_matching_keywords tells you how many papers share the question's words: if it is much larger than what
you have, page with offset or narrow with year_from/year_to or a more specific question. Read a whole paper with
get_paper. Quote passages verbatim and cite the paper; summarise rather than reword quotes from no-derivatives
(ND) papers. Covers only open-access papers in PubMed Central; methods sections are not indexed.

tools.name: protein_structure
tools.description:
Predicted 3D structure of a gene's protein: its UniProtKB accession(s) (Ensembl Plants protein matches) and the
AlphaFold Protein Structure Database model for each, with mean pLDDT confidence and the fraction of residues in
each confidence band, plus viewer and file links. gene: symbol or Ensembl/IWGSC ID. Useful for judging whether a
coding variant or edit falls in a confidently folded domain. Cite AlphaFold DB (Varadi et al. 2024, Nucleic
Acids Res, doi:10.1093/nar/gkad1011) and UniProt.

tools.name: gene_pathways
tools.description:
Plant Reactome metabolic and signalling pathways of a gene (Gramene), with the top-level category and a link
to the pathway diagram. gene: an Ensembl Plants gene ID or a gene name/symbol. Pathways are projected from rice
by orthology, so say they are inferred. Use pathway_genes for the reverse (all genes of a pathway).

tools.name: pathway_genes
tools.description:
Genes in a Plant Reactome pathway: pathway is a name or words from it ('jasmonic acid biosynthesis',
'gibberellin', 'flavonoid') or a stable ID (R-TAE-1119332). species: a species name as Plant Reactome writes it
('Triticum aestivum', 'Brassica napus', 'Glycine max'); default all species loaded for this site. Matching pathways
are listed with their genes per species. Membership is projected from rice by orthology.

tools.name: trait_hits
tools.description:
Trait-associated positions across the genome for a chromosome overview: GWAS marker-trait associations and
peaks, named trait genes and mapped trait loci held by this site, with chromosome sizes, each with a genome browser
link where the assembly is loaded. trait: words to match (e.g. 'height', 'oil', 'alkaloid'); chromosome filters
one chromosome. Map marker tracks are left out unless a chromosome is given. Tracks with karyotype false are on
another assembly than chromosome_sizes (pulse: soybean and common bean, Ensembl chromosome numbers; faba bean on
Hedin/2 v2 and projected v1; lentil CDC Redberry v2).

tools.name: genes_with_annotation
tools.description:
Find genes by function: GO term, InterPro or Pfam domain (accession or words, e.g. 'NB-ARC', 'IPR002182',
'GO:0009414', 'disease resistance', 'MADS-box') or Plant Reactome pathway ('gibberellin biosynthesis',
R-TAE-...; kind='pathway'). kind: GO, InterPro, Pfam or pathway (default: GO + InterPro + Pfam). Optional species
(Ensembl name) and region (chromosome, start, end in bp on the Ensembl/RefSeq v1.0 assembly) filters, e.g. all
NLR genes in a QTL interval. Returns matching genes with location, matched terms and genome browser link, plus
facet counts by species, chromosome and term. Annotations are electronic (InterProScan, GO from InterPro2GO).

tools.name: gene_neighbourhood
tools.description:
Gene neighbourhood (microsynteny): the gene and its flanking genes, with their orthologues in related genomes
(wheat homoeologues, Ae. tauschii, durum, barley, Brachypodium, rice) from Ensembl Compara. For each target genome, the collinear block holding most
orthologues of the neighbourhood is reported with how many neighbours are conserved there, so a candidate gene can
be checked for a conserved genomic context. flank: genes each side (default 8, max 25). targets: Ensembl genome
names (default ['aegilops_tauschii', 'triticum_turgidum', 'hordeum_vulgare', 'brachypodium_distachyon', 'oryza_sativa']).

tools.name: gene_papers
tools.description:
Papers mentioning a gene: Europe PMC search for its gene IDs (all versions, in open-access full text) and its
name/symbols (in title or abstract, with wheat/Triticum/Aegilops). Each paper says whether it matched an ID or a
name. Name matches can be another gene with the same symbol: check the abstract.

tools.name: annotate_genes
tools.description:
Annotate a list of genes (up to 500 IDs or names) in one call: resolved ID, species, location, name, top
InterPro/Pfam domains, GO terms, Plant Reactome pathways and orthologues in the main related genomes
(['aegilops_tauschii', 'triticum_turgidum', 'hordeum_vulgare', 'brachypodium_distachyon', 'oryza_sativa']). For gene-list follow-up after an experiment (DE genes, GWAS candidates); the web
page genes.html (gene-list tab) runs this and downloads a TSV.

tools.name: blast_sequence
tools.description:
BLAST a DNA or protein sequence (raw or FASTA; up to 20 kb DNA or 5,000 aa) against this site's databases:
Chinese Spring RefSeq v1.0 genome, RefSeq v1.1 CDS and proteins. The program is chosen from the query and database types (blastn, or blastn-short under 50 nt;
blastx; blastp; tblastn against CDS only). databases: ids from the list this tool returns (default: DNA query ->
reference genome + all CDS sets; protein -> all protein sets). Hits give gene ID (CDS/protein) or genome position
with overlapping genes, identity, alignment length, e-value and a genome browser link. People can use the
SequenceServer page at /blast/ for the same databases.

tools.name: wheat_gene_view
tools.description:
Interactive gene view for one bread wheat gene: a relationship map of its A/B/D homoeologues, orthologues
(durum, Ae. tauschii, barley, rice, maize, Arabidopsis and others), EMS knockout lines per copy, Watkins
haplotypes, expression responses and recent papers, with tabs for mutations along the gene and the haplotype
map. Clients that support MCP Apps show it in the chat; the result also lists the nodes and the askWheat gene
page link (page) to share. gene: symbol or any IWGSC ID.

tools.name: genesys_accession
tools.description:
Genebank accessions from Genesys (Crop Trust), live: full passport data (holder, accession number and names,
taxon, biological status, country and site of origin, coordinates, pedigree), whether the accession is available,
in the Multilateral System (SMTA) and safety-duplicated in Svalbard, whether the holder takes requests through
Genesys, a DOI where assigned, and the climate at the collection site (WorldClim: mean temperature, temperature
extremes, precipitation). accession: accession number (e.g. 'PI 591780', 'IG 32990'); holder: FAO WIEWS code
(e.g. USA029, LBN002, AUS165) to make it unique; name: free text (e.g. 'Chinese Spring') when the number is not
known; crop: Genesys crop code (wheat, barley, chickpea, lentil, pea ...) to narrow a name search.
